threat_model_and_remaining_assumptions.requirement: Root policy, nonzero generation floor and a fresh checkpoint must be independently provisioned and retained outside the restored owner state; restored input may not define its own expected root or snapshot.

Protect signing keys, revocation/rotation state and time/currentness services. Four pathname exclusions alone do not establish administrative independence, same-UID isolation or whole-host rollback resistance.

The runtime writer assumption and every real shared-store owner need explicit deployment enforcement; directly launched non-Agentd app-server/governance constructors are not covered by the Agentd startup gate.

Bind the delivered Node/Agentd binaries, selected deployed configuration, roots and ordinary/recovery/acceptance invocations to the reviewed pair with independent receipts. Signed source labels alone do not supply this binding.

Stable operation IDs, exclusive consumption, independent monotonic state and authenticated provider reconciliation must hold across crashes, lost replies, retries, competing writers and host rollback.
